question: As of March 2022, who is the President of the Indian Olympic Association?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narinder Dhruv Batra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narinder Dhruv Batra** is the President of the Indian Olympic Association as of March 2022.
 
• He has also served as the President of the International Hockey Federation (FIH).
 
• Batra has been actively involved in promoting and developing sports in India, particularly hockey.
 
• His leadership in the Indian Olympic Association has been marked by efforts to enhance India's performance in international sports events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Indian Olympic Association (IOA)** is the governing body for the Olympic Movement and the Commonwealth Games in India.
 
• The IOA is responsible for selecting athletes to represent India at the Olympic Games, Asian Games, and other international athletic meets.
 
• It also manages the Indian teams for the Commonwealth Games and South Asian Games.
 
• The association works towards the development of sports infrastructure and the promotion of sports culture in the country.
 
• The IOA was established in 1927 and is recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC).
 
• In addition to its role in organizing and managing India's participation in international sports events, the IOA also works to promote the Olympic values of excellence, friendship, and respect.
